stories.s: Replacing four layers of hardcoded, drift-prone banner-size constants with the backend's own size data to stop paid sponsor banners from being repeatedly cropped in production.
stories.pr: Sponsor banner sizing was governed by hand-maintained frontend constants that repeatedly drifted from the admin-panel upload sizes and design, causing paid sponsor images to be silently cropped in production - three real, customer-reported incidents in a short window, each a regression of the previous fix.
stories.wy: Recurring, customer-reported production incidents on paid placements made the pattern of patching exceptions on top of exceptions unsustainable; root-causing was judged cheaper than the next incident.
stories.oc: A plan to drive banner aspect ratios from the API's own per-breakpoint size object (already returned by the backend but never read by the frontend), removing the per-page exception maps, aligning skeleton and resolved rendering, and replacing a silent 16:9 crop fallback with a dev-time failure.
stories.pae: summary: sponsor banner sizing → Banner Ads

stories.pr: Attendees who clicked into a result (exhibitor, session, product, etc.) from Global Search had no way back to their prior search results or query, forcing them to redo the search from scratch.
stories.wy: Direct UX gap in the unified Global Search experience, part of the broader Search Anatomy initiative.
stories.oc: A "Back to search results" path now appears on detail pages reached via Global Search (restoring the query), consistently across all result types, and is absent when the detail page was reached any other way.

stories.s: Closed three code-quality gaps in the registration Tickets step - a duplicated constant, an unguarded null-price crash risk, and missing test coverage - with no visible change for participants.
stories.pr: A sold-out status key was duplicated across two files with nothing keeping them in sync; a ticket price field was destructured without a null guard despite one side of the codebase treating it as nullable, risking a crash on free tickets; and the component bridging registration to the shared tickets block had no test pinning its behaviour.
stories.wy: Found during code review of a related registration ticketing change (EP-56514); addressed proactively as robustness follow-ups before they could cause a production incident.
stories.oc: A single shared constant for the sold-out status key; a settled nullability contract with a guarded render path and test coverage for the price field; and a new render test pinning TicketingBlock's behaviour (event-over logic, currency/tax, features, page sizing, add/remove handlers).
stories.pae: summary: Ticketing step in registration → Ticket Purchasing (Online Registration also plausible)

stories.s: Documented that scanning a badge overrides a team member's GDPR opt-out but doesn't unlock their exhibitor's profile or Meet button, and asked for a decision on whether it should.
stories.pr: Scanning a badge is meant to make that person visible and contactable even with networking consent off, but the exhibitor profile's eligibility gate (team member list, Meet button) independently checks the raw GDPR flag and ignores the scan, so nothing changes for the exhibitor after a scan.
stories.wy: Surfaced as an unreconciled interaction between two existing rules (scan-overrides-GDPR, and exhibitor eligibility) rather than a defect against a written requirement; raised to force an explicit decision.
stories.oc: The ticket documents the gap and both possible resolutions (scan should also unlock the exhibitor, or an explicit statement that scan only ever unlocks the individual); this is a decision/description ticket, with no fix confirmed shipped in the text.
stories.pae: component Mobile App; badge scan of GDPR=0 team member

stories.s: Backend cache revalidation now hits the frontend's real endpoint directly, removing a redirect hop and a risk of silent stale-cache failures.
stories.pr: The backend's front-cache revalidation still targeted a pre-basePath URL that only works today via a temporary compatibility redirect; once that redirect is removed, revalidation would silently 404 and the site would keep serving stale cached content with no clear error signal.
stories.wy: Proactive fix to remove a latent breakage risk (silent stale-cache failure) tied to a planned cleanup of a temporary compatibility redirect.
stories.oc: Backend now calls /nextapi/revalidate/all directly in one hop instead of via the deprecated /newfront/api/revalidate/all redirect, verified with a single-hop 200 response on both the event and external domains.
stories.pae: frontend cache revalidation endpoint; infrastructure

stories.s: Rebuilt sitemap.xml and robots.txt generation on the frontend to fix broken, unindexable URLs and missing French-language pages that a client's SEO agency had reported.
stories.pr: The live sitemap for a client site (wineparis.com) was largely broken - 51 of 52 URLs were invalid relative paths pointing at redirecting addresses, no French URLs appeared at all, and robots.txt's Disallow directive was invalid - so French content stayed unindexed by Google, the exact issue the client's SEO agency reported.
stories.wy: Direct client-reported SEO issue (Vinexposium), and the frontend already owns the route tree and locale logic needed to generate this correctly, whereas the backend duplicates it and gets it wrong.
stories.oc: Frontend now generates absolute, redirect-free sitemap URLs per event language with reciprocal hreflang annotations, covering entity pages as well as site-builder pages, plus a corrected robots.txt with a valid User-agent line.
stories.pae: epic 'Technical SEO improvements' → SEO Management; sitemap.xml/robots

stories.s: Relocated 232 unit tests into co-located module folders under a new independent test root, decoupling the new DDD monolith's tests from legacy tooling.
stories.pr: Unit tests for the new src/ module-monolith code lived in a separate universal/ test tree rather than co-located with their modules, coupling the new architecture's tests to legacy tooling and blurring module boundaries.
stories.wy: Agreed architectural cleanup (design finalized 2026-09-01) to give the src/ monolith its own self-contained test setup as it matures, retiring the @group module-monolith convention and a stale, unused test tree.

stories.s: Added an explicit priority mechanism for integration-event listeners so execution order no longer depends on accidental module-registration order.
stories.pr: Listener execution order was implicitly determined by the order modules were registered (MODULE_PROVIDERS), coupling unrelated concerns and making it risky to reorder modules without unintentionally affecting listener ordering elsewhere.
stories.wy: Identified as a design fragility in the new DDD monolith that needed decoupling before it caused an accidental ordering bug.
stories.oc: An optional priority parameter added to listener registration, sorted at dispatch time with a stable sort preserving today's default order, with test coverage for both custom-priority and default ordering.
stories.pae: listener priority; architecture

stories.s: Moved round-table waitlist-replacement eligibility computation from an error-prone backend field into the matchmaking service itself, using data it already receives.
stories.pr: The round-tables replace API required the backend to pre-compute and send a filtered list of eligible replacement candidates for every declined seat, meaning it had to reconstruct, for every applicant ever, whether they'd ended up seated - something the backend found hard to compute reliably.
stories.wy: Improvement identified while implementing Story 3 of the Round Tables RFC; removing the backend's error-prone computation reduces integration risk between Data Science and the Hyve backend.
stories.oc: The Data Science service now derives eligible candidates itself (applied accounts minus every account already invited to a seat, across all generations and prior replacements) from data /schedule/ already receives; the unassigned_candidates field is removed from the contract entirely.
stories.pae: component Round Tables (not in table); epic 'Roundtable Allocation & Admin' → Round Tables waitlist

stories.s: Designed a payload-content search feature for the V3 Logs page (covering request/response body, not just metadata) plus a top-nav entry point opening it to clients as well as internal teams.
stories.pr: The V3 Logs page's filters only covered request metadata (event, date, method, endpoint, etc.); there was no way to search inside actual payload content, so investigating an API issue meant manually scanning JSON entries one by one, which doesn't scale.
stories.wy: Operational need surfaced from real API-issue investigations, plus a business ask to give clients (super admins) direct, self-service transparency into their own API logs.
stories.oc: A full design was produced for a multi-condition payload search (search-in / field / match / value, up to 5 conditions, 7-day window cap for cost control) running on existing CloudWatch Logs Insights with no storage changes, plus a top-nav entry point to the Logs page for both internal and client users; this ticket delivers the design, not the implementation.

stories.s: Assessed the health of iOS's dormant 99-test E2E suite to decide whether to revive or rewrite it as the verification gate for a planned automated bug-fix pipeline.
stories.pr: The iOS EPUITests suite (52 files, ~4,500 lines, 99 tests) had been dormant since November 2024, never run in CI, with unknown build and pass status - but it's intended to serve as the verification gate for a planned Sentry-bug-to-fix automation pipeline, so its real state needed to be known first.
stories.wy: Necessary discovery step before committing to reviving or rewriting the E2E suite as part of designing an automated bug-fix-and-verify pipeline.
stories.oc: A timeboxed (2-day) spike deliverable: a written report on build status, per-test pass/fail with failure-cause classification, fixture and account liveness, wall-clock run time, and a revive-vs-rewrite recommendation with effort estimates; no code changes.
stories.pae: summary: iOS EPUITests e2e suite assessment → native app build/verification (Mobile-only; test tooling)

stories.s: Fixed the web app manifest to cache for an hour like the site's icons, eliminating a needless full network round-trip on every single page navigation.
stories.pr: Next.js's built-in manifest route hard-codes a no-cache response header with no ETag, and because the manifest link is re-inserted into the page head on every App Router navigation, the browser re-fetched it in full on every page change, unlike the app's icons, which cache for an hour.
stories.wy: Performance and consistency fix found while auditing metadata caching, a companion to the earlier icon-caching fix (EP-55859), removing an avoidable per-navigation server round-trip for every visitor.
stories.oc: Replaced the Next.js file-convention manifest with a custom route handler serving the same manifest JSON with the same hour-long cache policy as the icons, verified to produce zero repeat network requests within the cache window.
stories.pae: component Website; web manifest caching

stories.s: Fixed admin-ui's static-asset caching, 404 handling and chunk count, and made the asset base URL configurable, unblocking a planned CDN rollout that cuts roughly 40% of server-facing static-file load.
stories.pr: ALB log analysis found ~40.7% of all server requests were frontend static files; admin-ui served them with no real caching (constant revalidation), let unknown asset paths silently fall back to the app shell (risking CDN cache poisoning and broken deploys), split its build into 437+ tiny chunks, and hard-coded its asset base path, blocking a planned CDN rollout.
stories.wy: Direct response to measured server and ALB load from static assets, and a required precondition for a planned DevOps step putting a CDN in front of admin-ui.
stories.oc: Immutable long-term caching for hashed asset files, real 404s for missing assets instead of the SPA shell, consolidated JS chunks (target 50 or fewer versus 437+), and a configurable asset base URL so DevOps can point builds at a CDN origin.
stories.pae: overrides component Admin Interface; admin-ui static-asset caching, 404s, chunking and CDN base URL — front-end infrastructure, no product feature

stories.s: Makes queue-based exports finish reliably by tracking batches explicitly instead of waiting for an exact row count that may never be reached.

stories.oc: init records the expected batch count, each batch marks completion idempotently, and finalize runs when all batches are done or failed, for all BaseExport exports.
stories.pae: summary: queue-based BaseExport finalize → Data Export
